The fuzz is hitting many states, but the connection closes early in most traces (mostly via LAYOUT or errors), which limits the depth of stream/crypto testing. Also FINAL_SIZE_ERROR and FLOW_CONTROL on streams are rare. Let me tune the fuzzer to generate "mostly valid" traffic so deeper semantics get exercised:

1. Make A packets always last in a datagram (avoid LAYOUT dominating).
2. Bias frames toward STREAM/CRYPTO with valid levels.
3. Install keys early.
4. Larger flow limits.

Let me create a second fuzz mode with "well-formed" generation, plus keep the chaotic one. Also increase the number of events per trace.

content.text: The fuzzer closes connections too early to exercise deep semantics. Let me add a "well-formed" fuzz mode.
